source.description: A pale snow harpy with frost-white wings half-spread, hovering gently, wings beating slowly, white hair and icy feathers drifting in the cold air. Seamless loop.
The pale snow harpy with frosted wings attacks — she rises with a sharp wingbeat, then dives toward the camera slashing with bird-like talons, then flaps back up into her hovering pose.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
